title: Preprocessor Pipeline Rules for Candidate Model Families

linear_regularized.rationale: Equalizes gradient descent penalties for L1/L2 penalties across diverse physical units.

bayesian_kernel.rationale: Prevents dimensions with huge raw values (e.g., carrier density 10^12) from dominating kernel distances.

tree_ensembles.rationale: Guarantees zero NaN entries across fold splits.

symbolic_regression.rationale: Avoids negative numbers and division by zero during transcendent operator evaluation.
